description:
Perform an outlier exclusion task on the 'age' variable in the BFI-25 dataset. 

1. Open the loaded 'BFI25.csv' dataset. 
2. Run 'Exploration > Descriptives' on the 'age' variable to find its Mean and Standard Deviation (SD). 
3. Create a new Computed Variable named 'Z_age' using the formula: '(age - [Mean]) / [SD]' (replace [Mean] and [SD] with the actual numeric values you found, e.g., 30.5 and 10.2). 
4. Apply a Data Filter to keep only cases where 'Z_age <= 2.0' (excluding outliers > 2 SDs above mean). 
5. Check the new mean of 'age' after filtering. 
6. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/Age_Outlier_Removal.omv'. 
7. Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/outlier_report.txt' containing exactly these 4 lines with your values:
   Original Mean: [value]
   Original SD: [value]
   Filtered Mean: [value]
   Excluded Count: [number of excluded rows]
